title: Decode-path quality campaign: offload vs hybrid

protocol.dataset: GSM8K test, first 40 rows (HF datasets-server), fixed jsonl
protocol.servers: offload vs hybrid --moe-hybrid-max-fetch 1, both --moe-cache-auto --max-running-requests 1, kv nvfp4 220032, memory-ratio 0.90
protocol.grading: final numeric answer (#### <n>), exact match vs gold

decision.quality_gate: PASS (no regression detected: identical accuracy, 0 discordant pairs, identical final answers)
decision.adopt_hybrid_default: permitted by this gate, but NOT switched in this task
decision.reason_to_wait: 40-item easy greedy subset at effort low; the residual risk is long-CoT divergence on hard reasoning, and hybrid perf was not measured at the adopted 220k/auto/mr1 shape
decision.recommended_next: prod-shape hybrid run (16k/64k/220k + full prefill, auto@mr1) and optionally a harder set (AIME25 cached) before switching the default

limitations: 40 items, greedy, reasoning_effort=low: limited power and does not exercise long-CoT chaos.
CoT text differs on 28/40 items even though answers match; greedys are not bit-identical between offload and hybrid.
Offload baseline here (13.78 tok/s) is at short context; the +40% is this workload, not the 220k decode.
AIME25 is cached on the host for a stronger follow-up.
